entries.land_location_as_stated: private home nestled in a rural setting, close to a beautiful, trout-stocked stream, and ruby gem mines
entries.description: Guest house in a private rural home near a trout stream and gem mines, with private room and bath, kitchen privileges and a fireplace. Also arranges women-owned vacation cottages and homes in the area. Welcomes girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: VANGUARD ENTERPRISES PO Box 1082, Franklin, NC 28734 (704)524-4453. Vanguard Guest House is a private home nestled in a rural setting, close to a beautiful, trout-stocked stream, and ruby gem mines. Accommodations include private room and bath, full kitchen privileges, shared common areas, living room with fireplace, and spacious deck (constructed by local women!). Warm, relaxed, friendly atmosphere where everyone is free to be themselves. Rates: $35 per night. Also, private, women-owned vacation cottages and homes in this area are available. Various styles, views, and locations. Most can house minimally four persons, and have decks and fireplaces. They have fully equipped kitchens and linens are provided. Smoking is an outside activity in most of the cottages. Rates range from $200 to $300 per week. Franklin is in the heart of the Smokies and a wonderful place to base your vacation. We welcome girl/boy children.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a guest house defined by what it offers visitors. PO box is never the land; land_city Franklin inferred since the listing says 'Franklin is in the heart of the Smokies' and the guest house is in this area. Accepted groups: 'We welcome girl/boy children' gives Girl children and Boy children. 'everyone is free to be themselves' is not coded as a group. Smoking ban only outdoors, not a focus.

entries.description: Cozy, private cabin for rent in Pisgah National Forest, furnished with antiques and women's artwork and books, with fireplace, kitchen and bath, open year round. Features woods and is accessible. Asheville has a large lesbian population.
entries.raw_text: BEAR'S CABIN c/o Ruth Bone, 70 St Dunstans Circle, Asheville, NC 28803 (704)254-0024 (after 5:30pm). Cozy and magical cabin in Pisgah National Forest. Exquisite. Private. Safe. Totally and tastefully furnished with antiques, women's artwork, women's books, waterbed, fireplace (and oil heat), phone, kitchen, bath. Year round. $45/day. Asheville is a resort area with a large lesbian population. I am/have: 1 lesbian, accessible, woods.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space, a rental cabin defined by what it offers visitors. The mailing address is a street address in Asheville but the cabin is in Pisgah National Forest, so land street, city and zip are left blank; land_state NC from the mailing state and the national forest. No groups named, so empty. 'accessible' is a questionnaire item, not coded as Disabled women focus. 1 lesbian count (questionnaire) with no statement of living on land, so num_residents left blank.

entries.description: Quiet women's campground on the headwaters of the Etowah River with tables, fire rings and primitive riverfront campsites. Friendly dogs welcome. Women live on the land.
entries.raw_text: SWIFTWATERS CAMPGROUND FOR WOMEN Box 2068, Dahlonega, GA 30533 (404)864-3229. Swiftwaters is a quiet place to camp on the headwaters of the Etowah River, deep in the woods. Plenty of tables, fire rings, and primitive river-front campsites. We welcome dogs (if friendly). We have: outhouse, woods, camping space, women living on the land.

entries.description: Small residential lesbian community of 10 separately owned cottages with a cultural/spiritual center, feminist library and health food store near the beach. Only lesbians can rent or own; all women may become members and stay in the center's bedrooms. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children and non-lesbian women visitors. Rules on smoking, alcohol and meat in the center.
entries.raw_text: THE PAGODA 2854 Coastal Hwy Vilano Beach, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a small residential lesbian community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center. Only lesbians can rent or own, but all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms in the center, as well as use our feminist library and health food store. Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor, no cooking or eating of meat, fish or fowl on main floor. We have a BBQ pit and flesh may be eaten elsewhere in the building. No nudity on our property or on the beach directly in front of us. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors. We are/have: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country, ocean, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative, a 'small residential lesbian community' of 15 resident lesbians. Street address on Coastal Hwy so copied to land. Residents: 15 resident lesbians; the 90 members from all over are not counted. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (residents), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women visitors' and 'all wommin are welcome to become members'), Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Lesbian separatism ('Only lesbians can rent or own'); Spirituality/ritual ('cultural/spiritual center'); Archives/cultural work ('feminist library'). Alcohol and smoking rules apply only to the main floor of the center, so Recovery/substance-free is not coded. Listed in the land directory; rows kept per codebook for a lesbian community on its own property.

entries.description: Bed and breakfast in Orlando, Florida, offering accommodations from a single room with shared bath to a whole house, with a swimming pool and exercise room and continental breakfast. Welcomes non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: SAFARI SOUTH 4310 S Semoran Blvd Suite 661, Orlando, FL 32822 (407)282-7847. Florida is America's favorite pastime and Safari South is in its heartland. Minutes from world-famous attractions and less than an hour from the ocean shore, we offer bed and breakfast accommodations ranging from single room with shared bath to whole house availability. Each unit offers AC/heat, TV/radio, and continental breakfast in a facility with swimming pool and exercise room. We welcome nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space, a bed and breakfast defined by what it offers visitors. The mailing address is a suite number at a business address, so land is left blank. Accepted groups: 'We welcome nonlesbian women' gives Non-lesbian women. It is a bed and breakfast with a pool and house, treated as a place with its own property.

entries.description: Bed and breakfast in Orlando with private entrance, bath, living room and bedroom, shared kitchen with the resident couple, and full breakfast. Offers information on the local scene, attractions and night life.
entries.raw_text: CLADDAGH COTTAGE B & B PO Box 574081, Orlando, FL 32857-4081 (407)282-4146. A bit of o'Ireland in Orlando. Private entrance, bath, LR & BR. Shared kitchen with resident couple. Full breakfast you fix at your convenience. Info and directions to local "scene," attractions, and night life. 1-3 persons is $29-$63 per night with discounts and specials for longer visit. Central heat and A/C, TV & Atari, off-street parking. "You'll be back if you try us once."
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space, a bed and breakfast defined by what it offers visitors. Mailing is a PO box, never the land; land city Orlando from 'A bit of o'Ireland in Orlando'. No groups named. Resident couple noted but no count of community residents.

entries.description: Private home offering a bed and breakfast as an alternative to male-owned hotels, with a suite and a double room, a deck, woods, birds and tropical vegetation. Quiet, restful and smoke-free, convenient to airport, beaches and Everglades.
entries.raw_text: TROPICAL DREAMS BED'N'BREAKFAST c/o C Brewer, 7600 SW 50 Ave, Miami, FL 33143 (305)666-5203. We're a private home offering an alternative to male-owned commercial hotels. We have one suite consisting of a bedroom, full bath and living room with a sofa bed. Also one double room with (sometimes shared) bath. This one has a wall of sliding glass doors that open out onto our deck. Lots of woods, birds, tropical vegetation, racoons, cats. Quiet, restful, smoke-free. Convenient to airport, beaches, Everglades, all tourist attractions and the road to Key West.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space, a bed and breakfast defined by what it offers visitors. Street address given and the listing is a private home with woods, so copied to land. No groups named. 'smoke-free' is only a tobacco ban, so no Recovery focus.

entries.description: Guest place with two guest rooms and bath, two platform tents, a cabin, picnic shelter with fireplace, gardens, a pond and woods, plus camping and a summer music festival on July 22-24, 1988. Donations for overnight stays; work exchange available. Welcomes girl children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: DEGREES OF FREEDOM 10055 Kline Rd RD #2, W Salem, OH 44287 (just off I-71, 50 miles south of Cleveland, 90 miles north of Columbus). We have two guest rooms and bath, two platform tents, a cabin that sleeps four, picnic shelter with fireplace, gardens (herb, vegetable, fruit, and flower), a pond for swimming, fishing, boating, skating, and studying pond life, places for tenting, woods, and a summer music festival July 22-24, '88. We're near Amish country, herb farms. You can cook out, go to town to eat (1 mile), cook in, or take potluck with the household. Donations appreciated for overnight stays (guest room $11, cabin $7, platform tent $4, camping $2/person). Work exchange available. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space, defined by what it offers visitors (guest rooms, cabin, tents, camping). Street/road address with RD, so copied to land. Location as stated from the parenthetical and 'near Amish country, herb farms'. Accepted groups: 'girl children, nonlesbian women'. Focus: Archives/cultural work from 'a summer music festival'. Gardens are mentioned but not as a food-growing goal, so no Farming focus.
